query: SELECT workspace_domain.id, CONCAT(name, '.', tld) AS "name!", is_verified, last_verified, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM workspace_domain INNER JOIN RESOURCES_WITH_PERMISSION_FOR_LOGIN_ID($2, $3) AS resource ON workspace_domain.id = resource.id WHERE workspace_domain.workspace_id = $1 AND workspace_domain.deleted IS NULL AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR CONCAT(name, tld) ILIKE '%' || $4::TEXT || '%') AND ($5::BOOLEAN IS NULL OR is_verified = $5) AND ($6::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_verified >= $6) AND ($7::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_verified <= $7) ORDER BY resource.created DESC LIMIT $8 OFFSET $9;
